caseName: Smith v. Montgomery Cnty. Sheriff's Office
caseNameFull: Billy M. SMITH v. MONTGOMERY COUNTY SHERIFF'S OFFICE

opinions.text: Motion of petitioner for leave to proceed in forma pauperisdenied. Petitioner allowed until October 27, 2014, within which to pay the docketing fee required by Rule *32738(a) and to submit a petition in compliance with Rule 33.1 of the Rules of this Court.
